text:
mika: Quick ask — can someone run a small-burst cb microbench on p4d-staging? I want to validate the new queueing heuristic that favors smaller batches under short bursts. Aim: 60s run, bursty arrival (lambda spikes), report p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and tail-violation (>1% of requests above SLO).

Config I'm thinking:```batch_delay_ms: 6
max_batch_tokens: 4096
prefer_small_batches: true
loadgen: bursty
requests: 1000
```
Command: `./run_cb_bench --config small_burst.yaml --duration 60`
Can you post the raw numbers and any weird logs? @sam @jules :eyes:

sam: I can run it. Do you have the YAML in the repo or should I paste it into the job? Also will run with the standalone loadgen seed=42 so results are repeatable. Any specific CPU/RAM for the loadgen box?

mika: repo path is `infra/bench/configs/small_burst.yaml` (just updated). Loadgen on t3.large is fine for the 60s run, just keep the loadgen far from the GPU host. Use seed=42. Thanks!

jules: Running on p4d-staging now, job queued (job id 577). I'll paste results when done. Note: enabling prefer_small_batches toggles the new queueing heuristic in runtime PR #1438.

ops-bot: job 577 started on p4d-staging — https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/577

jules: Quick results from job 577: p50=40ms, p95=210ms, tokens/sec=18,200, tail_violation(>300ms)=0.8% (8/1000). Observed ~2 spikes where batch formation waited for KV cache refill and that added ~120–150ms. Attached snippet of logs:```[2026-03-17T14:12:23Z] batch formed size=8 tokens=672 delay=6ms
[2026-03-17T14:12:24Z] kv-cache-miss, fetching shard=3
[2026-03-17T14:12:24Z] batch delayed extra=132ms due to kv-cache
```

lee: Can you also run the baseline (prefer_small_batches=false) so we have a direct comparison? I noticed in canary earlier this heuristic reduced throughput slightly in long-tail workloads. Also please add a metric `batch_delay_effective_ms` so Console can break down how much queueing is contributing to latency.

jules: Yep will run baseline next. Creating follow-up job 578. ops-bot should post when done.

ops-bot: job 578 started on p4d-staging — https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/578

jules: Baseline results (job 578): p50=55ms, p95=180ms, tokens/sec=19,100, tail_violation(>300ms)=0.6% (6/1000). Notes: higher tokens/sec but slightly lower p95; the heuristic trades a bit of throughput for tail reduction in bursty cases.

mika: Perfect, this is exactly what I wanted. Action items: (1) add `batch_delay_effective_ms` to the PR so we can graph it in Console; (2) add a short note in the PR description with these two job ids and the key numbers; (3) lee to review runtime PR #1438 for the metric naming and fallback behavior.

lee: Ack, will review PR #1438 today. If we like the metric name, I'll wire it into the per-route dashboard.

sam: thanks — will also add a short test to infra/bench to run small-burst as part of smoke so we catch regressions.

mika: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
